build_ptresnet50_model: build a PTResNet-50 model using Bottleneck blocks with optional layer freezing via freeze_until
build_ptresnet18_model: build a PTResNet-18 model using BasicBlock blocks with optional pretrained weights
build_ptresnet101_model: build a PTResNet-101 model using Bottleneck blocks with optional pretrained weights
create_custom_ptresnet: create a custom PTResNet model by passing a block class and layer depth list
freeze_batchnorm_layers: freeze BatchNorm layers up to a specified layer using bn_freezing_wrapper_in_place
